name: io.github.MongLong0214/commitlore
title: CommitLore
description: Git-native decision memory for coding agents: only the decisions still in force for the edited path

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.registryFit: Distribution is a tagged git checkout plus a Claude Code plugin marketplace (ADR-0011 registry-free git distribution, ADR-0026 no compiled executables and no uploaded release asset), so no official package type applies and this record relies on websiteUrl plus publisher metadata.

runtime.note: The repository whose decisions are delivered is the process working directory, so the host must launch the server with cwd set to that repository.
